text:
marta: quick brain snack — if we could retire one corporate phrase (eg 'circle back', 'touch base'), what would you rename it to? drop just the new phrase. i'll start: 'circle back' -> 'reopen later'

kai: 'touch base' -> 'check in' :+1:

sophie: 'take this offline' -> 'move to DM' :speech_balloon:

devon: 'bandwidth' -> 'capacity' (no more telecom jargon pls)

omar: 'low-hanging fruit' -> 'easy win' 

kai: 'sync' -> 'quick sync' or even '5-min huddle'

sophie: 'synergy' -> 'people working well' :joy:

marta: also propose 'circle back' -> 'revisit' (shorter)

devon: 'action item' -> 'next step' feels nicer

omar: 'let's table this' -> 'pause for now' (less furniture)

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: new staging deploy finished :robot_face: (no phrase changes but celebratory)

kai: love the 'pause for now' one. adding vote: +1 :thumbsup:

sophie: this could be a t-shirt: "replace jargon" :laughing: 

marta: ok i'll compile the list and make a silly doc to reference in meetings. anyone wants to add after lunch, drop here. :salute:
